## Page 4

BCH’s activities highlights in Q3/2025
4The Company held the groundbreaking ceremony for 
Kasemrad Hospital Suvarnabhumi  The hospital is located in 
an area of continuous economic and residential growth 
(Bangna –Suvarnabhumi) and supports healthcare expansion 
into the Eastern region. Construction will begin in October 
2025 , with an expected opening in 2027 .
The Company held the groundbreaking ceremony for 
Kasemrad Hospital Rayong ,marking the expansion of its 
hospital network into Eastern Thailand. This expansion 
aims to strengthen business operations and meet the 
growing demand for medical services. Construction will 
begin in October 2025 , with an expected opening in 2027 .

## Page 5

BCH’s activities highlights in Q3/2025
5
A+
A
BCH has received a corporate credit rating upgrade from A to A+ with a Stable 
outlook by TRIS Rating , reflecting its strong operating cash flow, solid financial 
position, and sustainable long -term business growth potential.
BCH has been awarded a 5 -star “Excellent” corporate governance rating for the 
third consecutive year, reflecting the Company’s strong commitment to good 
governance, transparency, and accountability to all stakeholders.
Kasemrad International Hospital Vientiane has achieved JCI (Joint 
Commission International) accreditation , becoming the first hospital in 
Lao PDR and the fifth within the Kasemrad Hospital Group to receive this 
prestigious recognition. The accreditation reflects the hospital’s 
unwavering commitment to continuously improving the quality and 
standards of patient care.

## Page 6

BCH’s activities highlights in Q3/2025
6
Kasemrad Ari Radiation Oncology Clinic has partnered with the National 
Health Security Office (NHSO)  to enhance the quality of cancer patient 
service. Under this collaboration, patients covered by the Universal 
Coverage Scheme are able to access high -quality medical services 
conveniently, promptly, and equitably through the Cancer Anywhere 
initiative. Kasemrad Hospital Prachachuen has partnered with the National Health 
Security Office (NHSO)  to provide cardiac surgery services for pediatric 
patients with congenital heart disease. This collaboration aims to reduce 
surgical waiting times while offering children a renewed opportunity for a 
healthier and brighter quality of life.

## Page 7

BCH has received three prestigious executive awards in the 
healthcare sector for the second consecutive year at IAA 
Awards for Listed Companies 2025 , presented by the 
Investment Analysts Association. The awards include 
Outstanding CEO, Outstanding CFO, and Outstanding IR, 
reflecting strong recognition and confidence from analysts, 
fund managers, institutional investors and retail investors.BCH’s activities highlights in Q3/2025
7Kasemrad Hospital Sriburin received the “Outstanding 
Workplace in Labor Management and Safe Workplace 
Award, Chiang Rai Province 2025,” presented at the Chiang 
Rai Provincial Administrative Organization by the Chiang Rai 
Provincial Labour Protection and Welfare Office, reflecting 
strong internal labor management practices and a safe 
working environment for employees.

## Page 8

BCH’s activities highlights in Q3/2025
On17September 2025 ,theRoyal Thai Embassy inKuwait organized “Rediscovering Health and Wellness Tourism inThailand” attheHilton Garden InnKuwait .The
event aimed tostrengthen bilateral cooperation between Thailand and Kuwait inhealth services and medical tourism, while reinforcing Thailand’s position asa
regional Medical Hub inlinewith Kuwait Vision 2035 .World Medical Hospital, under BCH, also joined theevent and showcased four keyspecialized centers :the
Diabetic Wound Center, WMC New Frontier Cancer Center, Robotic Surgery ,and Robotic Rehabilitation Center .The program also featured business matching
sessions that enabled direct discussions onpotential collaboration, including patient referral systems, medical personnel exchanges, and joint training programs to
expand healthcare partnerships .
